notes.title: About the 'Primordial Genesis' story.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871493/aecc61c22b6866be510ae17cad52251653441171.png[/img]

Hi everyone! A few words about my games. All the games you can find on Steam were created based on stories I've written. 'Primordial Genesis' is no exception. This game will be made in the form of a visual novel, with the story drawn from my first major book (which I'm currently writing). The book will also be titled 'Primordial Genesis,' with its central theme revolving around immortality. What does immortality mean for beings made of biological components, and what does death mean at all? Is death the separation of the soul from the body, or is it simply the cessation of biological functions that sustain a living organism?

Both the game and the book are currently in development, and I hope I will have more news about them soon. In the meantime, you're welcome to experience my debut game, 'At the Dream End,' available on Steam at: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251670/At_the_dream_end/?fbclid=IwAR1I6QAOKRgbApJEbaCdGWKkcrBXpixRn029bnBQVvCXM6sTEHhkPTgY7pg ]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251670/At_the_dream_end/?fbclid=IwAR1I6QAOKRgbApJEbaCdGWKkcrBXpixRn029bnBQVvCXM6sTEHhkPTgY7pg [/url]

Additionally, you can check out the story the 'At the Dream End' game is based on by downloading the PDF version, available in both Serbian and English, here: [url=https://payhip.com/markovicmartin?fbclid=IwAR2_uLyZ1pIruAyk08Gf0QYUIyWswDL6G8Uzd-Uz9x67fCIxbWEfgmoO13k]https://payhip.com/markovicmartin?fbclid=IwAR2_uLyZ1pIruAyk08Gf0QYUIyWswDL6G8Uzd-Uz9x67fCIxbWEfgmoO13k[/url]

notes.title: 'Primordial Genesis' trailer and news!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I am currently working on a demo version of the game 'Primordial Genesis.' The demo will contain story chapter 1 (out of the five chapters), and it should be done by the end of next month. Also, I am working on an OST for the game (in FL Studio 20). I am trying to create an atmospheric instrumental that will hopefully enhance the horror sci-fi atmosphere of the story even more. You can hear one of the game's instrumentals in a new trailer. Speaking of the trailer, here you can find one that shows a bit about the story and the atmosphere I am going for.
